chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin Khris' thu a bulnote nusia-in picinna lam manawhsuak ni. Phuhkik a kul nawnlo khuambul kimkhat om a, tuate pen: na-a kimanglo nasepte pan kisikna, Pasian upna,
baptize vai hilhcianna, khutngakna, misite' thawhkikna, tawntung thukhenna, cih thute hi.
Hihte pen Pasian in hong phal leh i sep ding ahi hi.
A hang pen a piang theilo thu khat om a, lungvakna a ngah khinsa, vantung deihguat thupha zong a ciam khinsa, Kha Siangtho zong a sang khinsa,
Pasian' kammal a hoihna leh hong tung ding khanghun ii vangliatnate a ciam khinsa,
hinapi tua panin a pialkhiakik a om leh amau' ading mahin Pasian' Tapa a khailumkik, milak ah a simmawhbawl ahih manun tua mite kisikna a neihkik nading uh piang thei nawnlo hi.
A hang pen ama' tunga a tusuk zelzel guahtuite a hup, amah a hah a kho mite' adingin kimanna a nei anteh theipuam a piangsak leitang pen Pasian' kiangpan thupha a sang ahi hi.
Ahih hangin tua leitang in lingnei kungte leh sialtalling kungte posak hileh amah a kimanna om lo-in haamsiatna a thuak ding hi pah a, ama' lamtawp pen kikhulna ahi hi.
Hih bang kong gen uh hangin kong itte aw, note' vai ah ahihleh thulelate-hotkhiatna tawh kisai thulelate-hoihzaw cih ka lungmuang uh hi.
A hang pen tu dong mah na zopsuak uh ahi mi siangthote donna huhna ah na sepkhiatte uh ahi zongin, ama' min' adinga na lahkhiat uh itna ahi zongin hong awlmawh lo dingin Pasian a thutanglo hilo hi.
Tua hi a, lametna thu ah a tawp dongin lungmuanna a dimtak na neih nadingun note khat ciat tua bang kinna nam na lahkhiat ding uh nakpi-in kong deihsak uh hi.
Tua pen note thadah lo-in upna leh lungduaina tungtawnin thupha kamciam a luah mite a etteh na hih ding uh deihsakna ahi hi.
A hang pen Pasian in Abraham' tungah kamciam a piak lai-in a kiciampih dingin amah sanga lianzaw om lo ahih manin amahmah kiciam a,
“Peel lo-in nang thupha kong pia ding a, kong pungsak ding hi,”ci hi.
Tua hangin Abraham in lungduaitak ngak a, kamciamna gah ngah hi.
A hang pen mite a kiciam uh ciangin amau sangin a lianzaw tawh kiciam uh a, a kinialnate uhah kiciamna cih pen thulela a kipsak a tawpkhak thu ahi hi.
Tua hangin Pasian in ama' kamciam kikhel ngeilo ahihna thu, kamciam a luah dingte' tungah a kitelzaw thamin a lahnop ciangin kiciamna khat tawh na kamkhap hi.

Tua hi a, a kikhel ngeilo tua thu nih tawh Pasian' lampan zuau gen ding cih a piang theilo thu ahih manin tua pen amah a va beel eite' adingin i mai-a hong kikoihsak lametna thu kiptak i let cinten nading hansuahna khauh ahi hi.
Tua i lametna pen inndei puanpid nung a sungtawng dong tungsuak ahih manin tua in sikkawikipe khat bangin i nunna kha hong bitsak hong kipsak hi.
Melchizedek guizui, tawntung siampi lianpenpaa suak Jesu pen tua inndei sungtawng ah eite' taangin a kihilkhol dingin a na pai khin ahi hi.
